# Too Good Maids

Too Good Maids is a local cleaning service business serving Eddyville, Princeton, Marion, Cadiz, Kuttawa, Benton, Grand Rivers, and surrounding communities in Western Kentucky. The business provides residential cleaning, commercial/office cleaning, short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO) turnover cleaning, and home organization services. The company helps homeowners, small businesses, and rental property hosts with reliable, practical cleaning support.

## Primary Entity

- Name: Too Good Maids
- Owner: Michelle Grant
- Location: Kuttawa, KY 42038 (Western Kentucky, service-area based)
- Service area: Eddyville, Princeton, Marion, Cadiz, Kuttawa, Benton, Grand Rivers, and nearby Western Kentucky communities
- Website: https://www.toogoodmaidscleaning.com
- Contact: toogoodmaidscs@gmail.com
- Phone: (270) 777-7920

## What Too Good Maids Does

Too Good Maids provides professional cleaning for homes, small businesses, and short-term rental properties across Western Kentucky. Services are booked through a free estimate request on the website; the company emphasizes reliability, trust, and a satisfaction guarantee.
